headlines.title: Vance talks 2028, Ted Cruz and a tough midterm climate that could affect his future
headlines.description: Vice President JD Vance said the GOP faces an “uphill climb” in the midterms — and that the results may be a data point he reviews as he decides his 2028 plans.

headlines.title: How 16 undecided voters are weighing their 2026 election options
headlines.description: The voters, who participated in a recent NBC News poll and spoke to reporters afterward, are laser-focused on high prices and largely disappointed with both parties.

headlines.title: Hochul appoints Letitia James as special prosecutor in Cornell sexual assault case
headlines.description: New York Gov. Kathy Hochul has issued an executive order appointing Attorney General Letitia James as special prosecutor in the Cornell sexual assault case. NBC News’ Gadi Schwartz has the details.

headlines.title: Text messages shed light on Jane Doe’s alleged sexual assault
headlines.description: The text messages exchanged between Jane Doe and some of the men accused in her lawsuit shed light on how her understanding of her night at the Chi Phi fraternity house in 2024 appeared to evolve. NBC News’ Maggie Vespa reports.

headlines.title: Botched execution of death row inmate
headlines.description: Tennessee gave death row inmate Christa Pike two doses of a lethal drug, but somehow she survived. NBC News’ Jesse Kirsch reports.

headlines.title: U.S. pressures European allies to release diesel reserves as Trump considers export ban
headlines.description: The Trump administration asked European allies to release diesel from their emergency stockpiles to increase global supplies and tamp down on soaring prices.

headlines.title: Sean Combs in solitary confinement following NBC News exclusive
headlines.description: A source with knowledge of the matter tells NBC that Sean Combs was moved to solitary confinement Wednesday, a day after our exclusive reporting. NBC News obtained and showed video of Combs using a contraband cellphone behind bars earlier this week. NBC News’ Chloe Melas has the latest.

headlines.title: New video of hero passengers from plane attack
headlines.description: New video showed the heroic Israeli passengers who subdued a co-pilot who tried to bring down their FlyDubai flight. President Trump said the co-pilot has links to Iran. NBC News’ Matt Bradley reports.

headlines.title: What we know about the pilot hailed as a hero for averting crash of Israel-bound plane
headlines.description: He is being hailed around the world as a hero for helping stop a passenger plane bound for Israel from plunging into the ground, despite his own severe injuries.

headlines.title: Screaming, panicking, blood: Passengers detail horrifying Israel-bound flight
headlines.description: It was too early to say why a pilot stabbed another on the flight from Dubai to Tel Aviv, according to Israeli Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu.

headlines.title: Mike Tomlin Reveals His ‘Minecraft’ City With Full Tour
headlines.description: After Mike Tomlin’s reveal of his “Minecraft” hobby on Craig Melvin’s “Glass Half Full” podcast went viral, the legendary NFL coach released a nearly 20-minute long video diving into his city planning.
